title: Kiddie Friendly Croatian Celery Casserole
description: A tasty and kid-friendly Croatian dish featuring celery, with a mustardy and crumbly texture, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This Mediterranean-friendly casserole is made with mortar-pestle-pounded ingredients for added flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a mortar and pestle, pound the chopped celery until it is well bruised.
In a large bowl, mix together the pounded celery, bread crumbs, grated cheese, mustard, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
In a separate bowl, beat the eggs until they are well mixed.
Add the beaten eggs to the celery mixture and stir until everything is well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
